objects.description: [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) has used websites with malicious hyperlinks and iframes to infect targeted victims with [Crimson](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0115), [njRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0385), and other malicious tools.(Citation: Proofpoint Operation Transparent Tribe March 2016)(Citation: Unit 42 ProjectM March 2016)(Citation: Talos Transparent Tribe May 2021)
objects.description_fa: [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) از وب‌سایت‌های دارای پیوندهای مخرب و iframe برای آلوده کردن قربانیان هدف به [Crimson](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0115)، [njRAT]([[[CTI_PRESERVE_5]]) و سایر مخرب‌ها استفاده کرده است. ابزارها.(Citation: Proofpoint Operation Transparent Tribe March 2016)(Citation: Unit 42 ProjectM March 2016)(Citation: Talos Transparent Tribe May 2021) https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0385
